qualityBoundaries: Every facet, event and relationship retains source, time and trust; co-occurrence and research subject do not prove identity or relationship.

Research is disabled by default; existing source switches, budgets, cancellation and forget epochs apply.
limits: No real-model quality evaluation or hallucination-rate measurement in this task.
No real-account end-to-end collection or long-duration live-stream acceptance.
Public research is bounded, may be delayed, and does not guarantee complete biographies, every event or daily refresh of every person.
